---
title: "Slingshot analysis of remade human dataset"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
author: "Chris Hill"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(biomaRt)
library(cowplot)
library(dplyr)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrastr)
library(grid)
library(here)
library(JASPAR2020)
library(scAnalysisR)
library(Seurat)
library(slingshot)
library(TFBSTools)
library(tradeSeq)

source(here("src/common_setup.R"))
source(here("src/09_10_lineage_helpers.R"))

options(Seurat.object.assay.version = "v3")
ggplot2::theme_set(ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 10))

# Load in our Seurat object
seurat_object <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "05_final_human.rds"))
Idents(seurat_object) <- "Leiden_cluster"
```

```{r "Get analysis plots", fig.width=10,fig.height=4, echo = FALSE, include = FALSE}
# Subset the ductal clustesr from the combined object
ductal_clusters <- c(5, 8, 10, 19, 21, 27)
cluster_subset <- subset(seurat_object,
  subset = Leiden_cluster %in% ductal_clusters
)

# Convert to single cell experiment
sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(cluster_subset)

# Extract only the top 15 PCs for slingshot object
pca_subset <- reducedDim(sce, "PCA")
```

# Ductal Lineages {.tabset}
```{r "Human new pseudotime S10E19", fig.width=12,fig.height=7, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
# Load in fitgam calculations
fitgam_sce <- readRDS(file.path(fitgam_dir, "fitgam_human_ductal_s10e19.rda"))

# Calculate lineage associations from query genes
query_names <- get_query_names(cluster_subset, cluster_number = 10)
lineage_assocRes <- associationTest(fitgam_sce, lineages = TRUE)

# Get the slingshot curves from the subset Seurat object
curves <- get_curves(
  seurat_object = cluster_subset,
  sce = sce,
  reduced_dim = pca_subset,
  reduction = "umap",
  start_cluster = 10,
  end_cluster = 19,
  dataset = "human"
)
```

## S10E19 L2
```{r "new lineage 2 plotting S10E19", fig.width=12,fig.height=5, echo = FALSE}
# Calculate lineage 2 for the ductal slingshot curves
lineage_plot <- getplots(
  sce = sce,
  slingshot_sce = curves$slingshot_sce,
  all_curves = curves$all_curves,
  seurat_object = seurat_object,
  slingshot_seurat = cluster_subset,
  dimension = "umap",
  lineage = 2,
  pseudotime_limit = 70,
  trim_index = 9000,
  dataset = "human"
)

# Print slingshot lineage plot
print(lineage_plot)
```

```{r "ductal lineage 2 plotting S10E19 heatmap", fig.width=10,fig.height=12, echo = FALSE}
# Create lineage heatmaps
plots <- make_lineage_heatmaps(
  slingshot_sce = curves$slingshot_sce,
  gene_list = query_names,
  object = cluster_subset,
  lineage = 2,
  lineage_asso_res = lineage_assocRes,
  waldcutoff = 200,
  pval_cutoff = 0.05,
  save_dir = image_dir,
  fraction = 70,
  dataset = "human"
)

# Print significant genes heatmap
print(plots$sig_genes_plot$heatmap)
```

# Acinar Lineages {.tabset}

```{r "Get analysis plots - acinar", fig.width=10,fig.height=4, echo = FALSE, include = FALSE}
# Subset to acinar clusters only in combined dataset

cluster_subset <- subset(seurat_object,
  subset = Leiden_cluster %in% acinar_clusters
)

# Convert to single cell experiment

# Extract only the top 15 PCs for slingshot object
pca_subset <- reducedDim(sce, "PCA")
```

```{r "Human new pseudotime S10E2", fig.width=12,fig.height=7, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}

# Calculate lineage associations from query genes

lineage_assocRes <- associationTest(fitgam_sce, lineages = TRUE)

# Get the slingshot curves from the subset Seurat object
curves <- get_curves(
  seurat_object = cluster_subset,

  reduced_dim = pca_subset,

```
